title: RAG-Based QA Bot
problem: Enterprise knowledge bases are hard to query — employees waste time searching docs instead of getting direct answers.
role: Solo developer — designed architecture, built retrieval pipeline, implemented eval harness.
outcome: Achieved 89% answer accuracy on internal eval set; reduced avg. query time from 3 min (manual search) to <3s.

title: AI-Powered Multi-Input Assistant
problem: Handling multimodal inputs (text, images, documents) through a single interface requires routing to specialized models with fallback logic.
role: Solo developer — built React frontend with Node.js server-side proxy, implemented multimodal routing, fallback logic, and client-side file processing.
outcome: Deployed on Vercel with serverless functions; per-IP rate limiting at 20 req/min; XSS sanitization; localStorage persistence with blob-stripping.

title: Smart Task Prioritizer
problem: Task management lacks intelligence — users need AI-driven priority scoring, energy-aware scheduling, and habit clustering to prevent burnout.
role: Solo developer — designed two-service architecture (Next.js frontend + FastAPI AI service), implemented priority scoring, energy-aware scheduling, K-Means habit clustering, burnout detection.
outcome: Frontend on Vercel, AI service on Render (non-root Docker), Supabase PostgreSQL, Sentry + PostHog monitoring; sliding-window rate limits, CSP headers, IDOR checks.
